**The problem you are trying to solve**

Describe the task, not just the feature. "I need to load this into BigQuery and
the CSV header names don't match" is far easier to act on than "add a --schema
flag".

**What you would like it to do**

**Alternatives you have considered**

**Would this need a third-party dependency?**

This project is deliberately dependency-free — it is why it runs anywhere with
no build step. Features that require a new runtime dependency are unlikely to be
accepted, though there is often a standard-library route worth exploring
together.
